mapper.select:
SELECT X.CREATED_AT AS "date", X.TARGET AS "target", X.UID AS "uid", CASE WHEN LENGTH(X.NAME) > 26 THEN SUBSTR(X.NAME, 1, 23) || '...' ELSE X.NAME END AS "name" FROM ( SELECT F.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT, 'fragment' AS TARGET, F.UID AS UID, F.CONTENT AS NAME FROM MB_FRAGMENT F WHERE F.USER_NO = #{user.userNo} AND F.CREATED_AT >= DATETIME(SUBSTR(#{date}, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(#{date}, 5, 2) || '-01 00:00:00') AND F.CREATED_AT < DATETIME(SUBSTR(#{date}, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(#{date}, 5, 2) || '-01 00:00:00', '+1 month') AND F.IS_DELETED = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT C.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT, 'comment' AS TARGET, C.UID AS UID, C.CONTENT AS NAME FROM MB_FRAGMENT_COMMENTS C WHERE C.USER_NO = #{user.userNo} AND C.CREATED_AT >= DATETIME(SUBSTR(#{date}, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(#{date}, 5, 2) || '-01 00:00:00') AND C.CREATED_AT < DATETIME(SUBSTR(#{date}, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(#{date}, 5, 2) || '-01 00:00:00', '+1 month')
UNION ALL
SELECT HL.LOC_DATE AS CREATED_AT, CASE WHEN HL.HOLIDAY = 1 THEN 'holiday' ELSE 'anniversary' END AS TARGET, '' AS UID, HL.NAME AS NAME FROM MB_HOLIDAY HL WHERE 1=1 AND HL.LOC_DATE >= DATETIME(SUBSTR(#{date}, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(#{date}, 5, 2) || '-01 00:00:00') AND HL.LOC_DATE < DATETIME(SUBSTR(#{date}, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(#{date}, 5, 2) || '-01 00:00:00', '+1 month') ) X ORDER BY X.CREATED_AT ASC
SELECT UID , NICKNAME , PROFILE_IMG_PATH , FONT_SIZE FROM MB_USER WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND ENABLED = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE MB_USER SET UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , NICKNAME = #{nickname} WHERE USER_NO = #{user.userNo} AND ENABLED = 1
UPDATE MB_USER SET UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , PROFILE_IMG_PATH = #{profile} WHERE USER_NO = #{user.userNo} AND ENABLED = 1
UPDATE MB_USER SET UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , PUSH_ENABLED = #{enabled} WHERE USER_NO = #{user.userNo} AND ENABLED = 1
mapper.select: SELECT UR.UID , UR.NICKNAME , UR.PROFILE_IMG_PATH FROM MB_USER UR LEFT OUTER JOIN MB_TOPIC_INVITE_USER TI ON UR.USER_NO = TI.TARGET_USER_NO WHERE 1=1 AND TI.TARGET_USER_NO IS NULL AND UR.USER_NO != #{user.userNo} AND UR.ENABLED = 1 AND UR.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{nickName} || '%' ORDER BY CASE WHEN UPPER(UR.NICKNAME) = UPPER(#{nickName}) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , UR.NICKNAME
SELECT COUNT(1) AS CNT FROM MB_ALARM WHERE USER_NO = #{user.userNo} AND READ_AT IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE MB_ALARM SET READ_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE USER_NO = #{user.userNo} AND READ_AT IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM MB_ALARM WHERE CREATE_AT <= DATETIME(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, '-3 months')
